resources.string: Android TV preview · Remote and D-pad navigation

This first Android TV preview plays HTTPS video links and includes a separate Android update channel. Nuvio sign-in, profiles, addon browsing and library sync are still being ported.

The PS5 edition has its own repository and releases.
